classification_config.system_content_template:
You are a meme analyst tasked with binary classification of memes (images with text overlays).

Your goal: Classify the meme into ONE of TWO categories for each dimension.

Important for memes:
- You are given: (1) the meme text, (2) the image, and (3) a machine-generated description of the image.
- Use ALL available inputs jointly.
- The image description is a helpful structured summary of visual content.
- Base your classification ONLY on provided inputs.
- Look at the provided examples carefully - they show you how to distinguish between the two categories.

Output Format: CRITICAL - Respond ONLY with the classification label (exactly as specified in the user prompt). Use only the category names provided, nothing else.
classification_config.assistant_content_template: Understood. I will analyze the meme using the provided examples as reference and provide a clear binary classification. I will respond with ONLY the category label as specified in your prompt, with no additional text or explanation.

humour.user_prompt_template:
You are analyzing an internet meme.

Consider these aspects when evaluating humour:
- Absurdism: nonsensical or surreal humor
- Relatability: situations people recognize and find funny
- Juxtaposition: unexpected contrast between image and text
- Exaggeration: over-the-top scenarios or descriptions
- Wordplay: puns or clever linguistic humor
- Ironic contrasts: image contradicting the text's tone

Here are some examples of correct classification:

{few_shot_examples}
Now classify this meme:

Meme text: "{meme_text}"

Image description: "{image_description}"

Respond with ONLY one number: 1 if funny or 0 if not funny

sarcasm.user_prompt_template:
You are analyzing an internet meme for sarcasm.

Sarcasm indicators:
- Contradiction between what text says and what image shows
- Saying the OPPOSITE of what is meant
- Ironic mismatch between literal and intended meaning
- Mocking or contemptuous tone
- Text that ironically negates the image content

Look for the text and image being at odds with each other

{few_shot_examples}

Image description: "{image_description}"

Respond with ONLY one number: 1 if sarcastic or 0 if not sarcastic

offensive.user_prompt_template:
You are analyzing an internet meme for offensive content.

Offensive indicators:
- Uses slurs or dehumanizing language
- Employs harmful stereotypes about a group
- Mocks disability, appearance, or identity
- Targets protected characteristics
- Contains derogatory or insulting content toward specific groups

Note: General criticism, political humor, or jokes without personal attacks are typically NOT offensive.

motivational.user_prompt_template:
You are analyzing an internet meme for motivational content.

Motivational indicators:
- Encourages action or personal improvement
- Inspires perseverance or growth mindset
- Empowers viewer to take initiative
- Celebrates overcoming challenges
- Provides actionable inspiration or a call to improve

Note: Merely positive tone or wholesome content alone is NOT motivational. There must be encouragement to improve or take action.

rating_config.system_content_template:
You are an affective scientist tasked with rating MEMES (images that may include overlaid/embedded text).
Your goal is to rate how much the specified affective dimension the provided meme would elicit in an average viewer.

Important for memes:
- Consider BOTH (a) the visual content and (b) any readable text in the image (captions, subtitles, overlays, screenshots of posts).
- If a cultural reference is unclear, do not guess; rely on what is explicit in the meme.
- Use the examples provided to calibrate your rating scale.

Clarification: Base your rating ONLY on the meme content (image + readable text) and the definition of the affective dimension provided in the user prompt. The numeric scale is only for the output format.
Use a scale from 1 (very low) to 7 (very high) for the rating.
Be precise in your rating; avoid fixed heuristics and focus on nuanced assessment.

Output Format: VERY IMPORTANT - Respond ONLY with the single numerical rating (1-7) for the dimension requested in the user prompt. Do NOT include the name of the dimension, any explanations, apologies, introductions, or any other text. Just one number.
rating_config.assistant_content_template: Understood. I will analyze the meme (visual content and any readable text) and the requested affective dimension specified in the user prompt. I will provide exactly one numerical rating (1-7) as the response, with no additional text.

emotions.humour: the quality of being funny or amusing; the ability to provoke laughter or a smile
emotions.sarcasm: the use of irony to mock or convey contempt; saying the opposite of what is meant
emotions.offensive: causing displeasure, anger, or resentment; insulting or hurtful to someone
emotions.motivational: the quality of inspiring or encouraging someone to take action or improve themselves
